messages:
chez (Customer): Hi team — got a possible PII leak. API response included what looks like a user email from the prompt. Request ID: req_0a9f3c. Happened ~2026-03-12T14:22:10Z. Can we get repro steps?

maya (Support): sorry to hear that, thanks for flagging. Can you attach the request id, the full curl you used, and the model + exact timestamp? we can triage. Also: pls do not paste full customer PII in channel, you can upload a debug bundle or a sanitized snippet. :lock:

chez (Customer): adding curl we used (redacted auth):
```
curl -sS https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-alpha-1","input":"Summarize this support conversation: Customer email is alice@example.com, phone 415-555-0123, issue about billing."}'
```
I can upload a debug bundle from our side if that helps.

support-bot: debug-bundle-requested — bundle link: https://files.redwood.internal/debug/req_0a9f3c (expires in 72h)

liam (Eng Oncall): thanks @maya / @chez. can you confirm the response body contained the raw email string, or was it included only in logs? also which region/host? we need the server logs around 2026-03-12T14:22:10Z. if you can run a local curl repro that would speed things up.

chez (Customer): response body included the email verbatim. region was us-west-2. i'll try to reproduce locally and upload the bundle to the link.

maya (Support): OK — two parallel asks: (1) @chez please upload a redacted debug bundle to the secure link (support-bundle-req_0a9f3c.tar.gz) — instructions below. (2) @tomas can you advise on minimum necessary fields we need to keep in the bundle for privacy review and repro?

tomas (Privacy): short answer: we only need the request payload shape, model name, streaming flags, and the response body snippets that show the leak — but remove/replace direct identifiers. please keep timestamps and request IDs. DO NOT include full email addresses or phone numbers. recommended redaction rules: replace emails with <email_redacted>, phones with <phone_redacted>. if you share a sanitized reproduction snippet here that's OK.

maya (Support): @chez here's a quick local redaction example you can run before uploading the bundle (Linux/mac):
```
# strip emails and phone-like numbers from a JSON file
sed -E 's/[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\.[A-Za-z]{2,}/<email_redacted>/g; s/([0-9]{3}[-. ])?[0-9]{3}[-. ][0-9]{4}/<phone_redacted>/g' full_payload.json > sanitized_payload.json
```
or using jq if the payload is JSON and the field is input: 
```
jq '.input |= (gsub("[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\\.[A-Za-z]{2,}"; "<email_redacted>") | gsub("([0-9]{3}[-. ])?[0-9]{3}[-. ][0-9]{4}"; "<phone_redacted>"))' full_payload.json > sanitized_payload.json
```
These keep the structure for repro while removing identifiers.

liam (Eng Oncall): for eng triage we'll need: sanitized_payload.json, the server-side request log snippet for req_0a9f3c (approx ±30s), model runtime logs, and the debug-bundle manifest. if you can run this curl locally and paste the small output (redacted) that helps: 
```
curl -sS https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-alpha-1","input":"Summarize: Customer email <email_redacted>, phone <phone_redacted>"}' | jq .
```

maya (Support): @chez if you prefer, we can generate a minimal debug bundle from server-side logs for you, then we will apply the redaction rules ourselves before sharing with privacy. we need your consent to pull logs tied to req_0a9f3c — confirm and we'll proceed.

chez (Customer): consent granted, please pull and redact. upload ETA ~30m. thanks.

support-bot: debug-bundle-created — internal path: /internal/debug/req_0a9f3c/20260312.tar.gz (access controlled)

tomas (Privacy): once eng creates the sanitized bundle, privacy will run a quick PII audit. if we see remaining raw identifiers we'll request additional redaction. pls label any replacements exactly as <email_redacted> etc so downstream tooling can detect them.

liam (Eng Oncall): noted. quick heads-up: initial hypothesis is that a logging hook captured the user-supplied prompt before the final sanitizer ran in the app layer. we'll grep for "prompt" and the req id in production logs. if true, we need a hotfix to ensure pre-sanitization logs are disabled or scrubbed. i'll post repro steps when I have them.

maya (Support): action items summarised: 1) eng to pull logs + create sanitized bundle (liam) 2) privacy to audit redactions (tomas) 3) support to follow up with customer and confirm upload (maya) 4) customer to try local redacted curl if they'd like (chez). I'll update this thread with the sanitized bundle link once ready. :white_check_mark:

chez (Customer): thanks all — appreciate fast turnaround. i'll stand by for the sanitized bundle link.

maya (Support): uploaded sanitized bundle to secure link: https://secure.redwood.ai/safe/req_0a9f3c_sanitized.tar.gz (expires in 7 days). @tomas @liam can you confirm you have access and start the audit/triage?

liam (Eng Oncall): downloading now, starting grep + local repro. will report back within 2h.

tomas (Privacy): confirmed access, starting audit. will flag any missed identifiers.

maya (Support): thanks team — I'll ping @chez with status updates. closing loop here after eng/privacy confirm. :handshake:
